abstract: INTRODUCTION: The curing of a testicular tumour is currently feasible in more than 95% of patients, and in 80% of those with metastases. Until now, there has been no study or series of cases that describe the ocular changes of the posterior segment associated with testicular cancer. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate patients with a diagnosis of testicular cancer in order to determine the presence of changes in the posterior segment and the relationship to the stage. MATERIAL AND METHOD: An observational, cross-sectional, and descriptive study was conducted on 21 male patients (42 eyes) with a diagnosis of testicular cancer. Age, histological type, time of evolution, stage, treatment, and comorbidities were recorded, as well as visual acuity measurement (LogMAR), biomicroscopy of the anterior segment, and photographic records of the posterior pole and peripheral retina. RESULTS: The mean age was 29 years (18-43 years). All (100%) of the patients were treated surgically. The most frequent histological type was classic seminoma (42.8%), followed by the mixed germinal tumour (38.0%). At the time of evaluation, 42.8% of patients had a stage II, and 23.8% had distant metastasis. The changes in the posterior segment were: vascular tortuosity (14.2%), retinopathy associated with cancer (9.5%), choroidal metastasis (9.5%), pigmentary changes of the retinal pigment epithelium (9.5%), and retinal metastasis (4.7%). CONCLUSIONS: It is possible to find changes at the level of retinal pigment epithelium, as well as vascular tortuosity, retinopathy associated with cancer, and choroidal and/or retina metastases.
abstract_ja: はじめに:精巣腫瘍は現在、患者の95%以上、転移のある患者の80%で治癒が可能である。これまで、精巣がんに伴う後極部の眼の変化を記述した研究や症例シリーズは存在しなかった。目的:精巣がんと診断された患者を評価し、後極部の変化の有無および病期との関連を明らかにすること。対象と方法:精巣がんと診断された男性患者21名(42眼)を対象に、観察的・横断的・記述的研究を実施した。年齢、組織型、経過期間、病期、治療、併存疾患を記録し、視力測定(LogMAR)、前眼部の細隙灯顕微鏡検査、後極部および周辺網膜の写真記録を行った。結果:平均年齢は29歳(18～43歳)であった。患者全員(100%)が外科的治療を受けた。最も多い組織型は古典的セミノーマ(42.8%)で、次いで混合型胚細胞腫瘍(38.0%)であった。評価時点で、患者の42.8%が病期IIであり、23.8%が遠隔転移を有していた。後極部の変化は、血管蛇行(14.2%)、がんに関連する網膜症(9.5%)、脈絡膜転移(9.5%)、網膜色素上皮の色素変化(9.5%)、網膜転移(4.7%)であった。結論:網膜色素上皮レベルの変化、血管蛇行、がんに関連する網膜症、脈絡膜および/または網膜転移が認められうる。
